_scope: Finalize Phase 2 Send only: phase 2 sends every new qualified candidate instead of cutting at the target. jsCode only.
_why: Owner decision 2026-10-03: "More than 20 / 40" means 20 / 40 or more, and every delivered candidate is billed 6 credits. The UI and backend promise a minimum ("Minimum candidates to return", "Return more than 20 candidates"); phase 1 never capped, but phase 2 sent only the shortfall - exec 2069 found 5 qualified in phase 2, sent 3 and dropped 2 after paying EnrichLayer and the model for them.
_expectedEffect: A search that reaches phase 2 can deliver more than its target; phase 1 is unchanged. Bounds: phase 2 fetches at most 20 / 40 profiles (and stays inside the shared 120 / 240 EnrichLayer ceiling), so a Tier 20 search delivers at most 19 + 20 = 39 and a Tier 40 one 39 + 40 = 79, each billed 6 credits. The credit pre-check (checkCredits) still covers only the target. Past the balance the backend still stores and shows a candidate but stops billing (applyHeadHunterInboundMerge persists before billNewHeadHunterCandidates, which returns at the first INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS), so extras past the balance are delivered free - existing behaviour, phase 1 already does it.
